description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Why the US had to fight the Second Battle of Fallujah street by street in 2004. After the first battle and a failed Fallujah Brigade, insurgents held the city. On November 7, 12,000+ coalition troops cleared it block by block until December 23—110 killed, 600 wounded, ~3,000 insurgents killed or captured. Years later, fast food in Fallujah became a stability signal. Comment which Iraq battle to cover next.
